title: Canot-Camping La Vérendrye
specs: Over 800 km of canoe routes and about 500 campsites
Most circuits are for autonomous and experienced clients
Water must be treated and filtered from nearby watercourses
Most campsites accommodate up to 10 people; fixed campsites accommodate 2 to 20 people
